text_block_list.text:
In the waiting room before the start of
the Japan
Cup, Симболи Рудольф
exchanges friendly greetings
with her
younger rivals.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But even when her thoughts are on the
past and
the future, her sights are on the
track. Today, as
ever, she will do her
duty as the Emperor.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
